texts.preamble: Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 27 May, 2020 Author: Siddharth Bench: Siddharth High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?In Chamber Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2633 of 2020 Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar
texts.facts: The instant Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with a prayer to grant an anticipatory bail to the applicant, namely, Pradeep Kumar, in Crime/FIR No. 0118 of 2020, under Section 56 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 , Police Station - Sayana Thana, District - Bulandshahar. Allegation against the applicant is that there was shortage in the food grains stock found by the Inspecting Officer. The applicant is an employee of Food and Civil Supplies Department. He was Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 27 May, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140011538/ 1 posted as Area Marking Officer. Submission is that as per the Government Orders dated 15.9.1990 and 15.7.2005, it is mandatory to initiate departmental inquiry before proceeding against the employee alleged to be involved in such offence. The applicant alleges false implication in this case without following procedure provided. He has serious apprehension that he may be arrested by the police in any time.
texts.arguments: Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant. In the event of arrest of the applicant shall be released on anticipatory bail till the submission of police report, if any, under section 173 (2) Cr.P.C. before the competent Court on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned with the following conditions:- (i) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police office as and when required; (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
texts.respondent_arguments: Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant.
